GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Blinkers again) Jumped Ok went to 3rd bit keen 4 Lengths . Leader went 8-10 Lengths Clear midrace. laid out rounding home turn now 5-6 Lengths off. tired last 100m # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced on the heels of another runner near the 1600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok ended up Just Off Mid-Field in between runners 8 Lengths . was 6 Lengths off on Straightening Up , worked to line fairly without threatening # bit one paced
(ex trevor montgomerie. Blinkers off, winkers again) Jumped Ok Drifted Back near tail 12 Lengths . Hard Ridden turning for home, passed a few tiring runners but was one paced # needs further

jumped awkwardly slow into stride went back to tail soon Out Of Picture . mile back turning for home, Out Of Picture again Soon After Straightening Up & was Not Sighted To Line (rider reported horse failed to muster any early speed & resented kickback) # rarely sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: JAA and as a result was slow into stride.  Laid out in the straight. RE the gelding was unable to muster any early speed  and resented the kickback in today’s event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (tongue clip on) Jumped Ok Settled in 5th 3 Lengths . Straightened Up 4 Lengths off, couldn't quicken just whacked away under hard riding # could do no better

Jumped Ok , got well back rails 7 Lengths 800m, still long way back and under riding sticking to inside Straightening Up , gap opened last 200m and powered home into an eye catching placing # ran on hard
Jumped Ok , Caught Wide So Went Forward to sit on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, was going backwards from the 500m and dropped out from then on being virtually eased down in Straight # eased down
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped away awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event. RR that the  gelding was disappointing in today’s event. Vet - NVA.
Rider accidentally dropped his whip near the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly raced keenly back ended up near tail 9 Lengths . went Out Of Picture midrace, mile back on Straightening Up , Out Of Picture again & Not Sighted To Line (vet - no visible abnormalities) # well Beaten
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.  Vet NVA.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to 2nd 2 Lengths . Took over near 600m, led narrowly into Straight . was clearly Headed @ 200m but he dug deep under hard riding & came back to score # pulled out plenty
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: hung out from near the 600m until the entrance to the  straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (compression hood with ear muffs on) Jumped Ok Drifted Back 3rd last 9 Lengths . was last turning for home, Hooked Out Wide in Straight , ran on last 100m # made late ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: RR after being obliged to settle further back  than expected, the gelding did not travel as well as anticipated through the middle stages of the  event. She further added that GALLOPING GURU (NZ) finished the race off strongly.
